items.title: OpenAI is pushing agents into everyday work
items.summary: TechCrunch looks at ChatGPT Work and Codex: OpenAI wants agents inside white-collar workflows, while usage is still far below ChatGPT itself.

items.title: Anthropic replaced Workbench with a stateless Playground
items.summary: The new Console Playground stores nothing. Old Workbench data must be exported by September 1. The piece compares it with OpenAI's prompt-testing UI.

items.title: Labs still won't publish how they'd contain a rogue model
items.summary: Guidelight graded frontier labs on containment plans. OpenAI scored highest; Anthropic and Meta were at the bottom of the published evidence.

items.title: Anthropic: the bottleneck moved past writing the code
items.summary: The AI-Native SDLC playbook argues reviews, handoffs, and gates sized for human speed break once agents write most of the diff.
